cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(binary_xyz_cpp VERSION 0.5.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
include(CTest)
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cpp/cmake")
find_package(OpenSSL REQUIRED COMPONENTS Crypto)
find_package(ZSTD REQUIRED)

add_library(binary_xyz_cpp cpp/src/binary_xyz.cpp)
add_library(binary_xyz::binary_xyz ALIAS binary_xyz_cpp)
set_target_properties(binary_xyz_cpp PROPERTIES EXPORT_NAME binary_xyz WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS ON)
target_compile_features(binary_xyz_cpp PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(binary_xyz_cpp PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cpp/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}>)
target_link_libraries(binary_xyz_cpp PRIVATE OpenSSL::Crypto ZSTD::ZSTD)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(binary_xyz_cpp PRIVATE /W4 /utf-8)
else()
  target_compile_options(binary_xyz_cpp PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()
add_executable(bxyz_cpp cpp/src/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(bxyz_cpp PRIVATE binary_xyz::binary_xyz)
add_executable(bxyz_md_example cpp/examples/md_writer.cpp)
target_link_libraries(bxyz_md_example PRIVATE binary_xyz::binary_xyz)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(bxyz_cpp PRIVATE /utf-8)
  target_compile_options(bxyz_md_example PRIVATE /utf-8)
endif()
if(BUILD_TESTING)
  add_executable(bxyz_cpp_api_tests cpp/tests/test_api.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(bxyz_cpp_api_tests PRIVATE binary_xyz::binary_xyz)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(bxyz_cpp_api_tests PRIVATE /utf-8)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME cpp_api COMMAND bxyz_cpp_api_tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/native_test_output")
  find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
  add_test(NAME python_cpp_interop COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env
    "BXYZ_CPP_CLI=$<TARGET_FILE:bxyz_cpp>" "BXYZ_CPP_EXAMPLE=$<TARGET_FILE:bxyz_md_example>"
    ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -m pytest -q cpp/tests/test_interop.py)
  set_tests_properties(python_cpp_interop PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()
install(TARGETS binary_xyz_cpp bxyz_cpp EXPORT binary_xyzTargets
  ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR} LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR} RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})
install(DIRECTORY cpp/include/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})
install(EXPORT binary_xyzTargets NAMESPACE binary_xyz:: DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/binary_xyz)
include(CMakePackageConfigHelpers)
configure_package_config_file(cpp/cmake/binary_xyzConfig.cmake.in "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/binary_xyzConfig.cmake" INSTALL_DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/binary_xyz)
write_basic_package_version_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/binary_xyzConfigVersion.cmake" VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION} COMPATIBILITY SameMajorVersion)
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/binary_xyzConfig.cmake" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/binary_xyzConfigVersion.cmake" cpp/cmake/FindZSTD.cmake DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/binary_xyz)
